title: Read several Git file contents
responsibility: Reads the requested paths at one Git revision in a single batch operation.

inputs.name: gitBlobs.root
inputs.description: The repository directory passed unchanged to 'git -C' for the read. The function relies on Git to reject an invalid or non-repository directory.

inputs.name: gitBlobs.request
inputs.description: Contains a Git revision and the paths whose blobs are requested; each path is sent as '<revision>:<path>' to 'git cat-file --batch'. An empty path list returns an empty map before Git is invoked, LF, CR, or NUL in any path is rejected, and other path or revision validation is left to Git.

outputs.name: gitBlobs
outputs.description: Resolves to a Map keyed by requested path whose values are the raw blob bytes as Buffer instances. Duplicate path keys collapse to one entry, and 'git cat-file' output is capped at 64,000,000 bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as an Error when any path contains LF, CR, or NUL, the 'git cat-file --batch' process fails (including its max-buffer limit), or a response header or blob size fails validation.
